name: Ultari Soldier (CR 4)
body:
Ultari Soldier
CR 4

XP 1,200
NE Medium outsider (evil, extraplanar)
Init +5; Senses darkvision 60 ft., scent; Perception +8
Aura fear aura (10 ft., DC 14)

DEFENSE

AC 15, touch 11, flat-footed 14 (+4 armor, +1 Dex)
hp 39 (6d10+6); fast healing 3
Fort +5, Ref +3, Will +6
Immune mind-affecting effects

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee ultari broadsword +8/+3 (1d10+2/19–20)
Ranged ultari plasma javelin +7 (3d6 electricity and 3d6 fire/x3)
Psi-like Abilities (ML 6th; concentration +7)

At will—detect good, telepathic lash
3/day—defensive precognition, mind thrust
1/day—brain lock, force screen PP 3

Special Attacks telepathic drain (DC 14)

STATISTICS

Str 14, Dex 12, Con 11, Int 15, Wis 12, Cha 13
Base Atk +6; CMB +8; CMD 19
Feats Improved Initiative, Toughness, Sickening Power [Metasionic]
Skills Bluff +8, Diplomacy +9, Intimidate +9, Knowledge (arcana) +8, Knowledge (planes) +8, Linguistics +3, Perception +8, Sense Motive +8, Spellcraft +10, Stealth +7, Survival +7, Use Magic Device +8
Languages Ashtuul, Belligren, Common, Jagladine, Onaryx, Ultari
SQ psychic drain, naturally psionic (+3 pp), ultari weapon affinity

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary, pair, or council (3-10)
Treasure NPC gear (masterwork omniweave armor, ultari broadsword, ultari plasma javelin)
